reply.summary: Lecorti is a scholarly outcast of a crime family who masks a murderous jealousy behind a courteous manner. Passed over by his father, he kills on dates marked for celebration.

feats.scene: Lecorti fires a pistol round point blank into a rival's chest in a candlelit study.
Lecorti is hurled down a stairwell by a pursuer and crawls out of the hall alive.

reply.summary: Lleulsir is a cruel crime heir who plots with a sister to seize a city's drug trade after their father's murder. A rival schemer gunned him down and used his death to spark a gang war.

feats.scene: Lleulsir shoots a defiant courier in a parking garage.
Lleulsir takes a beating from a street crew and still sneers at them.

reply.summary: Nauanrer is a quiet garage mechanic who loves his family and wants only a safe, ordinary home for his children. He keeps his cool when strange events circle his son.

feats.scene: Nauanrer cranks a stuck bolt loose with a wrench and a grunt.
Nauanrer slips from under a lifted car and bangs his head on a jack.

reply.summary: Vatele is a hardworking veteran and small-town mechanic who worries about his teenage son's strange new powers. He worked double shifts to keep the family afloat and accepts that parenting means facing whatever comes.

feats.scene: Vatele hauls an engine block onto a workbench with a heave.
Vatele is knocked flat by a backfiring tow truck and dusts himself off.

reply.summary: Sentite is a struggling painter turned forger who vows revenge after a hero exposes his counterfeits. He shoots trick arrows of every hue but one, in memory of a rival.

feats.scene: Sentite fires a tinted arrow that bursts a smoke canister over a cash truck.
Sentite is wrestled to the ground by two officers and wriggles free.

reply.summary: Tausti is the estranged son of a scientist-hero, raised by a fanatical soldier mother to rebuild her fallen regime. He leads, plans, and quarrels with his own father.

feats.scene: Tausti commands a volley from his followers that shatters a barricade of crates.
Tausti is flung across a briefing room by his father and waves off the bruises.

reply.summary: Telan is a high-ranking officer of an island of warrior women who judges outsiders with arrogant disdain. She draws steel after an insult and is flattened by a single punch.

feats.scene: Telan swings a drawn sword that bites through a wooden post.
Telan is knocked flat by a single brawler's fist and gets back up on her feet.

reply.summary: Saoro is a bone-sucking horror freed from a prison dimension who gorges on a ship's crew. Its enormous strength nearly kills a hero before a shapeshifting elder ends it.

feats.scene: Saoro rips a steel hatch off its hinges and flings it across the pier.
Saoro takes a crane's swinging hook to the head and snarls through the dent.

reply.summary: Aunntova was an ordinary ranch hand's partner until alien enemies cloaked her in a red crystalline shell. She grieves loudly and needs a strongman nearby to calm her.

feats.scene: Aunntova hurls a pickup truck across a field in a fit of grief.
Aunntova stands unmoved as a rifle volley glances off her crystal skin.

reply.summary: Saulu is a bullied orphan who steals a rare comic and is transformed into the costumed idol he worshipped. The wish turns on him as the curse tightens.

feats.scene: Saulu lifts a parked sedan to scare off a bully.
Saulu takes a heavy blow from a pickup and sits up dazed but intact.

reply.summary: Cisiu is a swamp-born orphan chosen by a living memory of color to bring back a vanished green world. He restores color for a moment to whatever he touches and travels toward a ruined capital.

feats.scene: Cisiu thrusts his hand into a frost-locked wall and a tide of roots bursts through it.
Cisiu shrugs off a spear thrust that should have pierced a lung.

reply.summary: Vorartal is a red-eyed plant guardian who bends toxins and vines to his will. He cannot be truly killed so long as roots still grip the earth.

feats.scene: Vorartal calls up a forest of thorned trunks that wrecks an entire city block.
Vorartal re-knits his torso after a crushing blast from an invading war engine.

reply.summary: Iumrntia is a bald, towering champion of all plant life who raises sentient children from the leaves of an emptied metropolis. He searches the ruins for the people who vanished.

feats.scene: Iumrntia bids the whole forest rise and swallows a downtown in green.
Iumrntia stands in the center of a burning skyline and grows back wherever he is scorched.

reply.summary: Irnvas guards the planet's greenery with one vow, to stand apart from human wars. He can swell or shrink at will, heal any hurt, and cannot die while a single leaf lives.

feats.scene: Irnvas thrusts a sprouting root through a fortress and tears it down.
Irnvas weathers a point-blank orbital strike and regrows by the next sunrise.

reply.summary: Ticeotan is a scientist-turned-swamp protector whose flaming accident merged him with the marsh. He wrestles dark experimenters and watches over bayou friends.

feats.scene: Ticeotan crushes a mutant brute's armor with a two-handed slam.
Ticeotan shrugs off a cluster of blasts that would flatten a house.

reply.summary: Sorse is a green plant-monster who saves a government agent from hired killers while his formula is hunted by a villain. He once fell into flames in his own lab.

feats.scene: Sorse hurls a gunman clear across a boathouse.
Sorse is hit by a shotgun volley and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Stuau is a lonely inventor who sews tiny teleport devices into his gloves and commits burglaries dressed in white. He vanishes through walls and always takes more than he needs.

feats.scene: Stuau drives a crowbar into a safe and cracks it before the alarm sounds.
Stuau is knocked down a flight of stairs mid-teleport and reappears across the room.

reply.summary: Minauni is a veteran interrogator and spy who masks his face and moves through shadowy cabals. He prizes secrets above loyalty and sneaks into guarded sites.

feats.scene: Minauni plants a silenced round in a compromised informant at a dockside meeting.
Minauni takes a rifle butt to the ribs and slips away through a service door.

reply.summary: Reoosni is a clawed, winged avenger of an ancient order of punishers, one of three sisters who hunt the guilty. She takes to the air and rakes her prey.

feats.scene: Reoosni dives from a cloud and tears the roof from a stone shrine.
Reoosni shrugs off a chariot ramming at full gallop.
Reoosni streaks across the moonlit sky on her beating wings.

reply.summary: Leomi is a half-alien teenager, hailed as the hope of a barren world. Her bloodline even supplied the cells that rebuilt her father's eyes.

feats.scene: Leomi shoves a heavy lab cart through a doorway to clear a path.
Leomi tumbles off a garden wall and picks herself up laughing.

reply.summary: Leoteeo is a tall, winged horror created when a prayer to a fiery demon answered a murderer's scream. Centuries later he kidnaps children and turns them into beastly copies of himself.

feats.scene: Leoteeo swoops down and rips a lamppost out of the pavement.
Leoteeo bursts out of a burning chapel and flies on, singed.

reply.summary: Llria is a towering warrior who envies a rival's destiny and gradually turns bitter. She loves, resents, and finally quarrels with the princess she once sparred with.

feats.scene: Llria cleaves a practice dummy in half with a blow of a heavy blade.
Llria is battered by her sparring partner's fists and refuses to yield.

reply.summary: Iumeoltin is a cold gang lord who rules a sprawling city and executes failed assassins. His anger at one bumbling vigilante grows with every arrested lieutenant.

feats.scene: Iumeoltin orders the shooting of a hired gun who botched a job.
Iumeoltin takes a thrown vase to the head without losing his composure.

reply.summary: Llole is a smooth political strategist hired to polish a campaign. Hidden mind control turns him into a pawn who traps the person he loves.

feats.scene: Llole slams a door shut on a locked chamber and drives the bolt home.
Llole drops to the floor under a tranquilizer dose and wakes hours later.

reply.summary: Serlo is a patient retiree who leads a town of aging crusaders and keeps a deadly secret about a spring that stops time. He lost his temper only once.

feats.scene: Serlo slaps a gavel so hard it splits the oak block.
Serlo takes a fall from a porch step and stays calm.

reply.summary: Lleeorti is a nightclub owner who dabbles in forbidden rites and loves his daughter. A summoned demon ends his life before she can warn him.

feats.scene: Lleeorti hurls a candlestick at a summoned shadow and watches it pass through.
Lleeorti is flung across the backroom by an unseen force and gets back up.

reply.summary: Nauti is a self-mutilated crime queen who sewed her eyes and lips open to mirror her inner scars. She runs a lair of traps and shares a dark bond with her sibling.

feats.scene: Nauti springs a snare that clubs an intruder across the face.
Nauti shrugs off a thrown knife and a chair across the back.

reply.summary: Cornil is a timid scholar of old texts who admits she is a coward. After death she is raised as a puppet soldier, fighting better than she ever lived while explaining how to break the spell.

feats.scene: Cornil tackles a sister warrior while her own body fights against her will.
Cornil takes a chariot strike in the ribs and keeps fighting, unable to stop.

reply.summary: Ninri is a bullied teenager transformed into a green, energy-draining creature by a cruel experimenter. He wants to finish the mission and go back to normal, and he refuses to see anyone hurt.

feats.scene: Ninri drains a hero's strength and lifts a crumbling beam off a trapped civilian.
Ninri takes a heavy battering from a hero and keeps draining.

reply.summary: Ilterium is a lonely occultist raised among cultists who imprisoned a being of dreams for decades. He spends his life trying to contact the captive.

feats.scene: Ilterium shoves a candle holder into a chalk circle to keep the ritual alive.
Ilterium falls across a stone floor and keeps chanting.

reply.summary: Terau is a farm-raised soldier and special forces veteran whose body was reshaped by a lab's genetic trigger. He later reunites with his estranged daughters.

feats.scene: Terau pounds a jeep's hood flat with a hammer-like fist.
Terau walks out of a grenade blast with only scorched fatigues.

reply.summary: Eontcor is an ordinary city resident who looks up in terror when the sky turns blood-red. He hopes his protector in the night is watching too.

feats.scene: Eontcor slams a shutter against the crimson glare.
Eontcor stumbles over a curb in the panic and gets back up.

reply.summary: Reaunto is a distant industrialist whose scavenged machines let a pair of salvagers build a warsuit. The suit's artificial mind obeys only his name.

feats.scene: Reaunto's warsuit punches a hole through a slab of concrete at a salvage yard.
Reaunto's warsuit stands through a rain of falling girders.

reply.summary: Rivalrer is a prison genius who builds high-tech weapons in the workshop and breaks out repeatedly. He joins a council of rival selves for the sake of conquest.

feats.scene: Rivalrer fires a homemade blaster that melts a guard's rifle.
Rivalrer is thrown across a hall by an energy beam and rises coughing.

reply.summary: Seresval is a proud adviser banished from a royal court for ignoring a warning. A cursed ring warps him into a pale, grinning madman.

feats.scene: Seresval rips a wagon train apart with a burst of ring-fed fury.
Seresval is struck by a champion's blade and laughs through the wound.

reply.summary: Lleeru is a ruthless magnate obsessed with a rival from the stars who crafts clones from stolen cells. He fights from an armored suit when persuasion fails.

feats.scene: Lleeru's armored suit smashes a reinforced door and crushes a turret.
Lleeru takes a point-blank hit from a hero while sealed in the suit.

reply.summary: Coseoar is a cackling tycoon who leads a league of villains and a snake-like portal that teleports on demand. He keeps rare green glowing stones nearby.

feats.scene: Coseoar steps through a ring of light and slams a hero from behind.
Coseoar rides out a pounding in his battle suit and cackles on.

reply.summary: Terasti is a bald schemer driven by envy, orchestrating a war and building living weapons in a cell. His speeches are venomous and his plans cruel.

feats.scene: Terasti triggers a chain of bombs that levels a stretch of frontier buildings.
Terasti is beaten in a cell by guards and still gloats.

reply.summary: Valori poses as a benevolent diplomat while quietly serving a shadow cabal. He speaks several languages and bends world leaders to his will.

feats.scene: Valori signs an order that sends a convoy of trucks into a mountain pass.
Valori takes a podium shove and recovers his smile.

reply.summary: Amoeoser is a charming tycoon posing as a philanthropist while hiring killers and murdering an infant from the stars. A camera trap exposes him, but bail frees him.

feats.scene: Amoeoser commands a pistol shot from a hired killer across a dark street.
Amoeoser is dragged off a stage by a masked kidnapper and brushes off the bruises.

reply.summary: Tutontel is a bald genius who rose from industry to a throne of worlds, shaping a company, a planet, and an office. He pursues a title of tomorrow with unshakable ego.

feats.scene: Tutontel unleashes a salvo from a hovering war engine that levels a downtown.
Tutontel stands inside his armor as a barrage of missiles burst against it.

reply.summary: Corre is a disembodied brain placed in a metal giant to resist alien invaders. His power source is torn out in battle, yet he helps strike down the enemy leader.

feats.scene: Corre punches through an invader's armored flank with a metal fist.
Corre takes a hail of invader blasts and fights on in emergency power.

reply.summary: Telnen is an opportunistic politician who exploits economic panic to win office. He outlaws masked heroes unless they serve him and arms himself with a battle suit.

feats.scene: Telnen's battle suit hurls a limousine across a plaza.
Telnen's battle suit withstands a hero's swing in a marble hall.

reply.summary: Niaamnu is a cartoonish tycoon who announces his new death ray in a press conference. He wears a battle suit and hoards glowing stones.

feats.scene: Niaamnu aims his ray at a billboard and vaporizes the whole thing in a blink.
Niaamnu bounces off a foam-padded stage wall in his suit and laughs.

reply.summary: Eonall is a scientist from a destroyed world who tries to perfect another by shipping villains to test subjects. He lives in a frozen fortress and manipulates a corporate matron.

feats.scene: Eonall detonates an experimental device that wrecks a laboratory complex.
Eonall is shoved against a freezer by a pursuing reporter and recovers quickly.

reply.summary: Tumseniu is a maimed genius with a mechanical arm who plans to release a power-restoring bomb under a metropolis. He betrays his old rival to do it.

feats.scene: Tumseniu sets off a device beneath a metropolis that tears the whole district apart.
Tumseniu grips a cracked railing as his old rival hurls him aside.

reply.summary: Torleourn is a former head of state who becomes a father figure to a young clone. He advises an army of heroes sent through time and fades with a changed timeline.

feats.scene: Torleourn raps a table and a squad of operatives steps forward.
Torleourn lurches back from an alien tentacle and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Saulen is a newborn whose body becomes a vessel for a conquering god. It drains the powers of nearby heroes and inherits its parents' cruelty.

feats.scene: Saulen siphons the strength of two giants and flings it back as a city-shaking pulse.
Saulen takes a cosmic shockwave without waking from its cradle.

reply.summary: Llitauta is a child prodigy of magnetism who believes he is a conqueror reborn. He kidnaps leaders and hides them in fields until a hero lures him away from his power.

feats.scene: Llitauta tears a bridge's girders free with a surge of magnetism and hurls them at a hero.
Llitauta stands in a storm of fire and steel, charged by captured machines.
